summary: End-to-end testing of Neraium SII Real-Time System Intelligence Platform (post-cleanup rebuild). All 16 pytest backend tests pass (root metadata, templates, playback start/stop/speed, system list/get/state/history/decision, audit auto-emit + manual + invalid + delete, FD004 truth sheet, WS subscribe+snapshot). Frontend Playwright covers full happy path: header brand+tabs+speed selector, START spawns 4 system cards (sys-A1 industrial, sys-A2 industrial, sys-E1 environmental, sys-G1 generic), card click opens SystemDetail with WHAT/WHY/DO/IF_IGNORED, future paths, variables panel, ACK button writes to audit log (visible on switching to Audit view), Validation view shows 97.58% coverage, all 5 alert quality bars and 3-method comparison, STOP returns to START state.

issues: Speed selector buttons are single-letter only ('S/N/F') with no visible tooltip; new operators may not realize they map to slow/normal/fast. Consider title/aria-label or a small caption.
When a system has 4-5 cards but only 4 are spawned, the 4th card sits alone on a new row (single column). Acceptable but a centered or full-width treatment for the orphan would feel less ragged.

critical_code_review_comments: Two MongoDB clients are created (one in server.py for db, one lazy in routers/audit.py via _coll()). Consider centralizing to a single shared client/dependency to avoid duplicate connection pools.

routers/ws.py mounts WebSocket directly on /api/ws/stream while api_router uses /api prefix; this is fine but inconsistent — a comment is useful for future maintainers (already partially documented in server.py).
AuditView polls every 3s AND there is a 2s server-side flush; under heavy regime churn the UI list could show duplicate-looking rows briefly. Not a bug, just UX awareness.
Frontend AuditView does not paginate beyond 200; after long runs the table grows unbounded in DOM. Add infinite scroll or limit cap with 'Load more' for production.
SystemDetail polls /history (300 frames) every 1s — this is heavy if many tabs open. Switch to incremental delta or use the existing WS to push history.
seed_data_creation: Playback started with speed=fast; default 4 systems registered automatically by services/playback.py. No manual seed beyond what the platform spawns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and require the `websockets` package (already installed). Tests assume REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points at the public preview URL (which is what frontend/.env contains). Playback is left RUNNING at fast speed at the end so the UI is immediately usable. Audit log table grows unbounded — be aware when re-running tests, the audit list selector returns 200 entries quickly. The /api/audit DELETE endpoint scopes by system_id query param; passing empty deletes all.
rca of the issue: No issues found — all features behave per spec.
